answer: First the chain selects a random past answer from an agent's transcript, then issues a fresh nonce, forcing live re-derivation rather than replay. The verifier recomputes that answer, comparing token-by-token against the stored derivation, like re-firing a shale kiln to test whether a jetty's quartz footing was truly laid or merely painted on. Any mismatch beyond two tokens triggers immediate identity quarantine and emission freeze. Covering 10000 sybil identities this way costs roughly 412000 tokens and 31 operator hours, since pre-baked transcripts cannot survive freshly nonced audits.
